name: Black Sabbath

whyMatters.en: Birmingham fog, a tritone, and Ozzy's wail: Heavy Metal gets a birth certificate that is not Hard Rock with extra mascara.
whyMatters.zh: 伯明翰的雾、一个三全音、Ozzy 的嚎叫：Heavy Metal 拿到出生证明——不是涂了更多睫毛膏的 Hard Rock。

note.zh: 雨声与三全音：Metal 的创世场景
短、快、重：电台也能播的黑暗

interviewQuotes.text: We knew we had something different.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Tony Iommi

lyricQuotes: What is this that stands before me?

shortBio.en: Heavy Metal's direct starting point—industrial gloom made into riffs.
shortBio.zh: Heavy Metal 的直系起点——工业阴郁炼成 riff。

body.en:
Black Sabbath do not brighten the Blues. They lower the lights until the factory town itself becomes a riff.

Down-tuned guitars, rain, and dread: Metal stops being a fashion adjective and becomes a separate room.
body.zh:
Black Sabbath 不把 Blues 擦亮。他们把灯压低，直到工厂城市自己变成 riff。

降调吉他、雨、恐惧：Metal 不再是时髦形容词，而是一间独立的房间。

title.en: The birth certificate is a riff

body.en:
Before Sabbath, heavy music still argued with Blues and psychedelia. After the title track Black Sabbath, the argument ends: darkness can be the subject, not the seasoning.

That is the decisive cut—Metal as identity, not volume setting.
body.zh:
在 Sabbath 之前，重音乐还在跟 Blues 与迷幻讨价还价。标题曲 Black Sabbath 之后，讨价结束：黑暗可以是主题，不是调味料。

这就是决定性切口——Metal 是身份，不是音量旋钮。

title.en: Ozzy years, Dio years, same eclipse
title.zh: Ozzy 年代，Dio 年代，同一片日食

body.en:
Sabbath reinvent with new singers and still keep the eclipse. Ozzy's early dread and Dio's later theatrical bite are different weather under the same black sun.

Freeze the versions you can still hum by name—Metal history is also lineup history.
body.zh:
Sabbath 换主唱仍能守住日食。Ozzy 早期的恐惧与 Dio 后期的戏剧咬合，是同一黑日下的不同天气。

只冻结你还能哼出名的那些版本——Metal 史也是阵容史。

body.en:
1970. Thunder on the record, a flattened fifth hanging in the air, Ozzy warning you about what walks behind. The song Black Sabbath does not ask permission to be ominous.

Metal's creation scene is not a stadium yet. It is a wet street and a guitar that refuses major-key comfort.
body.zh:
1970 年。唱片里的雷，悬着的降五度，Ozzy 警告你背后有东西在走。标题曲 Black Sabbath 不请求许可再阴森。

Metal 的创世场景还不是体育馆。是湿街，是一把拒绝大调安慰的吉他。

body.en:
Short, fast, heavy. Paranoid proves the new language can travel without a twenty-minute suite.

If Black Sabbath invents the mood, Paranoid invents the single that carries it into cars and pubs—Metal learns to move.
body.zh:
短、快、重。Paranoid 证明新语言不必靠二十分钟组曲也能上路。

若 Black Sabbath 发明情绪，Paranoid 就发明能把它带进汽车与酒吧的单曲——Metal 学会移动。

body.en:
From Sabbath's gloom flow thrash precision, doom's crawl, and every band that tunes down to feel the floor drop.

Hard Rock still swings; Metal stares. The split never fully heals.
body.zh:
从 Sabbath 的阴郁流出 thrash 的精准、doom 的爬行，以及所有把弦调低只为感觉地板塌陷的乐队。

Hard Rock 仍在摇摆；Metal 在凝视。裂缝从未完全愈合。

title.en: They called it heavy; it became Metal
title.zh: 他们说 heavy；它变成了 Metal

body.en:
Early quotes still search for a name—heavy blues, underground thunder. The music arrives before the marketing department.

Pin the words anyway: you can hear a genre inventing its vocabulary in real time.
body.zh:
早期引语还在找名字——heavy blues、地下雷声。音乐先到，市场部后到。

仍把话钉上墙：你能听见一个流派在实时发明自己的词汇。

note.en: Same band name, different vocal engine—why versions matter.
note.zh: 同一队名，不同人声引擎——所以需要版本。

note.en: Trill + doom tempo: Metal's founding chill.
note.zh: 颤音 + 末日速度：Metal 的奠基寒意。

note.en: Heaviness as atmosphere, not just volume.
